sources.quote: officers and directors in the aggregate filed more than 125 untimely Forms 4 to report transactions related to, among other things, stock and option awards, options exercises, and open-market sales.

notes: AgEagle is named in SEC enforcement (Sept 2023) for repeat late Forms 4, including stock option awards, March 2018 to June 2022. That window covers the lead's 2017-20 period and only the start of 2021-24; no source found reporting AgEagle lateness in 2023-24 or the 85-of-117 figure. No source found on Security National Financial late filings, and none on the cross-company persistence finding (13% or 20.3% vs 1.5%). The SEC's 2023 and 2024 sweeps describe using data analytics to find repeated late filers (pattern). Quotes from the two SEC order PDFs were taken from extracted PDF text; line breaks in the PDF may need whitespace normalization in the quote check. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found.
